//! produce. Generated by `forge/harness --bin gentests`.

//! The modules are bytes because assembling wasm needs a std crate.
//! The EXPECTATIONS are not written by hand either — every one was
//! produced by running the module here, on a compiler whose output is
//! checked against the interpreter case by case. So the device is
//! compared against something that was measured, not against
//! somebody's arithmetic.
